# ssp Provider

The **SSP** (Security Services Platform) provider manages deployed SSP cluster instances:
site onboarding, vertical security feature activation, backup/restore, telemetry, and certificates.

For Day-0/Day-1 SSPI appliance workflows (vCenter provider registration, package management, cluster
provisioning, scaling), see the companion `terraform-provider-sspi` provider.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Base HTTPS URL of the deployed SSP platform (e.g. `https://ssp.example.com`). May also be set via the `SSP_HOST` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) When `true`, TLS certificate verification for the SSP cluster is skipped. Defaults to `false`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSP enterprise admin password. May also be set via the `SSP_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `username` (String) SSP username. Must hold the `enterprise_admin` role — nearly every write operation across `ssp_*` resources requires it (alone, or paired with `auditor`); an `auditor`-only or `security_op`-only account can read via `data.ssp_*` data sources but will fail with an HTTP 403 on the first resource write. May also be set via the `SSP_USERNAME` environment variable.
